structured.rankingRationale: Top-ranked opportunities combine verified future dates, exact Toronto venues, direct infrastructure/medical/screen relevance and plausible participant travel. Rail Day, ICWE, EV & Charging Expo, CCECE and LabFaB outrank committed-venue or out-of-core opportunities because the hotel can credibly pursue delegates, exhibitors, speakers or side meetings without assuming an open room block.

notesForDeepResearch: Verify official housing, room-block, overflow and participant-arranged lodging terms.

materialUncertainties: Most candidates do not publish room blocks, peak rooms or attendance; silence is treated as unconfirmed rather than open.

Toronto-wide and Exhibition Place events may yield only overflow, speaker, exhibitor or side-meeting opportunities; none is treated as exclusive housing.
